description: A task whose budget deadline is 0 has its Cx cancelled with its own Deadline at time 0 (its sleep does not end on a Deadline). A driver cancel_task with a Deadline reason at 0 then ties with it (same severity and timestamp, no message): the record takes the driver's reason, but the Cx keeps its own (record/task.rs:839-850), and the outcome, classified with the Cx, reports the task's own Deadline (origin task t.0).
